knowledgeBaseName: Rally Forge VA Benefits Knowledge Base
description: Comprehensive VA disability compensation knowledge base combining regulatory authority (Part 3 & 4), precedential case law, presumptive conditions, state benefits, and rate databases

part3.name: 38 CFR Part 3 - Disability Compensation
part3.description: Complete VA regulations for disability compensation, effective dates, dependents, and compensation calculations

part4.name: 38 CFR Part 4 - Disability Rating Schedule
part4.description: VA rating schedule with diagnostic codes and percentage rating criteria for all disability types

cases.name: Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims (CAVC) Decisions
cases.description: Precedential case law providing interpretive guidance for regulatory application

rawExtraction.name: Raw Extracted Materials
rawExtraction.description: Original parsed materials from source documents

presumptiveConditions.name: Presumptive Conditions Database
presumptiveConditions.description: Comprehensive database of presumptive service-connected conditions by exposure type
presumptiveConditions.purpose: Quick lookup for presumptive condition eligibility based on service location and exposure

rateDatabase.name: VA Compensation Rate Database
rateDatabase.description: Official VA disability compensation rates organized by year with SMC, ancillary benefits, and dependent calculations
rateDatabase.purpose: Authoritative rate table source for compensation calculations

stateBenefits.name: State Veterans Benefits Database
stateBenefits.description: State-specific veterans benefits, programs, and resources organized by state
stateBenefits.purpose: Supplement federal VA benefits with state-level resources

tera.name: Temporary Early Retirement Authority (TERA) Database
tera.description: TERA program data, schemas, and processing engine for military retirement calculations
tera.fileFormat: Database schemas, engine logic, and UI components
tera.purpose: Support TERA retirement benefit calculations and eligibility determinations

vaKnow.name: VA Knowledge Crawler & Benefits Index
vaKnow.description: Crawled VA benefits data and indexed resources from VA.gov
vaKnow.purpose: Supplementary VA.gov data for benefits discovery and cross-reference

crossReferences.part3_to_cases: Regulatory rules linked to supporting case law
crossReferences.part4_to_cases: Diagnostic codes and rating criteria supported by precedent
crossReferences.cases_to_regulation: Case decisions referencing and interpreting regulations

usagePatterns.example: Find 38 CFR section → retrieve related cases

knowledge/.part4/: Rating Schedule Part 4 data (8,312 diagnostic codes)
knowledge/.VAknow/: VA benefits crawler and indexed resources

accessPatterns.byRegulation: Part 3/4 section → get cases citing that section
accessPatterns.byCase: CAVC case ID → get regulations it interprets
accessPatterns.byTopic: Search term → get matching rules + relevant cases
accessPatterns.byYear: Year filter → get cases from that year
accessPatterns.byDependentType: Spouse/Child → get relevant rules + case precedent
